fact: ATOP reports that on 25-27 February 2025 the mayors of Golfe 3 and Lacs 1, whose communes run a birth teledeclaration system, shared it with colleagues from the 16 communes of the Savanes region, who were to learn how to implement a similar system.
title: Modernisation des services d’état civil : Des maires des Savanes s’imprègnent des expériences des communes Golfe 3 et Lacs 1
